title: Evaluation and transpose for normalized scalar data
statement: Fix the data of semilinearScalarData for a compatible coefficient-system map. There exists a family of isomorphisms between system scalar extension followed by evaluation and level evaluation followed by level scalar extension, and these isomorphisms satisfy the specified transpose_evaluation equation under the derived scalar adjunctions.

proof.text: Define the ordinary evaluation comparison to be the inverse mate of the prescribed restrictionEvaluation_existsUnique isomorphism. Apply sequenceModulePullbackEvaluation_isIso for the identity site functor: its coextension/iterated-mate argument proves this ordinary comparison invertible for the supplied ordinary scalar adjunctions.

Define the derived comparison as the inverse mate of restrictionEvaluation under S.adjunction and (L n).adjunction. For a K-flat flat-term sequence complex P, evaluation is K-flat by systemSequenceEvaluation_preservesKFlat, after identifying the two vertical evaluation presentations. The supplied transpose_model equations hold for P and its evaluation. The mate-transpose identity, naturality of the exact-evaluation localization factors, and the ordinary mate unit identity give the representative comparison equation. Only normalization on these representatives is used.

Both derived scalar counits compute on the common representatives. Every factor on the ordinary-comparison side of the representative equation is invertible, hence the derived mate is invertible there by cancellation. Use siteSheafTensorRightIso to express the resolution terms as site-flat modules. Resolve any sequence complex by a K-flat complex with flat terms, then transport invertibility along its localized quasi-isomorphism and the essential-surjectivity isomorphism of DerivedCategory.Q.

Take the inverse of the resulting mate isomorphism as evaluation. The general adjunctionMate_transpose theorem gives exactly transpose_evaluation, with its two sides reversed. Package these two fields into ScalarEvaluationData.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; Stacks 06YS, 06YT, 07A4, 07A6 and 0FND. The representative mate calculation adapts the proved generic derivedMate_comparison calculation to normalization on a fixed K-flat representative.

theorem semilinearScalarEvaluationTranspose
    (F : ℕ → Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    (σ : ∀ n : ℕ, F (n + 1) ⟶ F n) (α : ∀ n : ℕ, B n ⟶ F n)
    (hα : ∀ n : ℕ, α (n + 1) ≫ σ n = τ n ≫ α n)
    (S : ScalarData.{c, v, max c v r}
      (systemMap.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ F σ α hα))
    (L : ∀ n : ℕ, ScalarData.{c, v, max c v r} (α n)) :
    Nonempty (ScalarEvaluationData.{c, v, r} J B τ F σ α hα S L)
